description: Decode a 17-character Vehicle Identification Number: offline structure check (allowed characters, ISO 3779 check digit, region and WMI, model-year code) plus NHTSA vPIC decoding (make, model, model year, trim, body class, vehicle type, doors, drive type, engine cylinders/displacement/fuel, transmission, manufacturer, plant city/country, GVWR, safety equipment) and optional open NHTSA safety recalls for that make/model/year. Public US government data. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/vin-decode

recalls.description: Include NHTSA recalls for the decoded make/model/year (default false)

vin.description: 17-character VIN (I, O and Q are not allowed)

year.description: Optional model year hint (resolves the 30-year cycle of the 10th-character year code)

name: vin_decode
title: Vin Decode
